caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vessel centered on a plain, light beige background. The vessel is bulbous with a rounded body, a narrower neck, and a slightly flared rim. It has two circular handles affixed to the neck on opposite sides. The surface of the vessel is depicted with a mottled texture, showcasing a combination of earthy tones such as brown, ochre, yellow, and greenish hues, along with darker spots that suggest staining or natural imperfections. The vessel's form and details are rendered with shading to give it a three-dimensional appearance, and there are faint pencil marks visible on the background, some of which are situated near the vessel's base. There is a small, cursive signature in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
